items.text: India’s economy is growing fast, and millions of people now have more money to spend on luxury brands like Louis Vuitton, Chanel, and Dior. However, these companies are facing a major stumbling block : there are not enough luxury malls in the country. Currently, India has only three true luxury malls—two in New Delhi and one in Mumbai. This is a tiny number for a country with nearly 1.5 billion people. Global luxury groups are ready to open more stores immediately, but high-quality retail spaces are not available. New mall projects are planned; however, they will not be finished until 2028 or later. Although India’s luxury market is growing, it is still less than 3% of the size of China’s market. To solve this problem, some brands are using franchises with local Indian retailers to enter the market faster. Until more malls are built, the promise of India becoming a global luxury leader can’t be fulfilled. Difficult words: stumbling block (something that prevents action or agreement), retail (selling goods directly to the public in small amounts, usually in shops or online), franchise (when a big company allows a local person to open and run a shop using the big company’s name). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

India is becoming a very rich country, and many people want to buy expensive bags and clothes. But there is a big problem: India does not have enough luxury malls . There are only three real luxury malls in the whole country. Big brands like Dior and Chanel want to open new shops, but there is no space for them. Experts say that India is growing faster than China, but the luxury market is still quite small. New malls will take many years to finish. Because of this, some foreign companies are working with Indian businesses to sell their products. If India wants to sell more luxury goods, it must build more high-quality places for people to shop. Difficult words: luxury mall (a very large, high-quality building with many expensive shops), luxury (expensive, beautiful, and high-quality), foreign (coming from a different country, not your own). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people in India are rich now. They want to buy beautiful bags and expensive shoes. But India has a big problem. There are only three big malls for luxury shopping. This is a big problem. Many people want to shop, but there are no places to shop. Companies like Dior and Chanel want to come to India, but they have no space for their shops. They must wait many years for new buildings. India is a very big country with many people, but the shopping centers are very small. They need more malls where people can buy nice things. It is important for the country to have more places to shop. Difficult words: rich (when you have a lot of money), mall (a big building with many shops and restaurants), luxury (expensive and beautiful). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A jury in New Mexico has delivered a major legal defeat to Meta, the company that owns Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. The state’s attorney general accused Meta of misleading parents and users about the safety of its platforms. The lawsuit claimed that Meta enabled child exploitation and failed to protect young people online. The jury ordered Meta to pay 375 million dollars in penalties. The attorney general described the verdict as a historic win and stated that no technology company is above the law. He argued that Meta prioritized profits over the safety of children. Meta, however, strongly disagrees with the decision and plans to appeal. The company claims it has made extensive efforts to keep its platforms safe. This case is part of a larger trend, as Meta faces thousands of other lawsuits. Many of these accuse social media companies of creating addictive products that harm the mental health of teenagers. A second part of this trial will start in May to decide if Meta must change its systems. Difficult words: attorney general (the most important lawyer in a state or a country), mislead (to make someone believe something that is not true by giving them wrong or incomplete information), exploitation (a situation where someone treats another person unfairly to gain an advantage or to make money for themselves), prioritize (to decide that one thing is more important than other things). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Meta is the company behind Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp. A jury in New Mexico says Meta broke the law and must pay 375 million dollars. The company told people that its apps were safe for children, but the jury found this was not true. They believe Meta didn’t do enough to stop bad people from hurting kids on the internet. Some officials say this is a big victory for families. They think Meta cares more about profit than about children’s safety . Meta doesn’t like what the judge decided and says it will fight again in court. Many other states are also angry with Meta. They say social media is like a drug that makes young people feel sad or sick. In May, a judge will decide if Meta must change how its apps work. Difficult words: victory (winning), profit (the money you make), safety (when you are safe from danger or harm). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Meta is a big company. It has Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. Now, Meta has a big problem in court . A jury says that the apps are not safe for children. Meta must pay a lot of money—375 million dollars. The leaders in New Mexico are happy with this news. They want to keep children safe. They say that Meta wants only money. But childrens’ health is more important. Meta says that it is not true. Meta wants to talk to the judge again. In May, the court will look at the apps again. Everyone wants the internet to be a safe place for young people. Difficult words: court (an official place where people listen to facts and say if someone breaks a rule), jury (a group of people who listen in court and decide if someone does something bad or not), health (how your body and mind feel). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Plastic is no longer just in our environment; it is inside our bodies. Microplastics and nanoplastics enter our bodies through the air we breathe, the skin, and especially through what we eat and drink. Everyday items like plastic cutting boards, bottled water, and microwavable containers release millions of particles. Once inside, these tiny invaders can pass through cell membranes and settle in our tissues. They cause long-term inflammation because the body can’t break them down. Besides physical damage, plastics contain over 16,000 chemicals. Some of these, such as BPA and phthalates, are so-called endocrine disruptors that disrupt our hormones. They are linked to serious health issues, including obesity, diabetes, and lower fertility. While we cannot easily remove plastic from our bodies, we can reduce our exposure by choosing natural fibers, using glass or stainless steel containers, and avoiding single-use plastics. However, experts say that solving this problem will require new laws and global regulations to limit plastic production. Difficult words: invader (a person or a thing that enters a place where it is not wanted), membrane (a very thin layer that covers and protects a cell), exposure (being in contact with something, such as sunlight, chemicals, or plastic, which might affect you). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Microplastics are tiny pieces of plastic. They are everywhere, and they get into our bodies when we eat, drink, or breathe. Plastic bottles or plastic containers release many particles of plastic into our food. These small pieces of plastic stay in our bodies and can make us sick. They cause inflammation because our body tries to fight them, but cannot destroy them. Plastics also carry dangerous chemicals. These chemicals can confuse our hormones and lead to problems like obesity or trouble having babies. We can help ourselves by making small changes, like using wooden cutting boards or glass jars instead of plastic ones. But it is not just our job; governments must also make new laws to stop companies from making so much plastic. Difficult words: release (to let something go), inflammation (when a part of your body becomes red and painful because it is trying to fight an injury or germ), confuse (to make something unable to work the right way). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Plastic is in our clothes, our food, and now in our bodies. We breathe it in the air and drink it in water. This is a big problem for us. These small pieces of plastic stay in our skin and our blood. They can make our bodies feel sick and tired. Our body cannot destroy them. We need to use less plastic every day. Do not use plastic bottles or plastic boxes for food. Use glass, wood, or metal in your kitchen. This is better for your health . We also need official rules to stop making so much plastic. If we all work together, we can make the world clean and stay healthy. Difficult words: breathe (to take air into your lungs and let it out again), destroy (to damage something badly), health (how well or sick you feel). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Philippines has declared a state of national energy emergency due to the conflict in the Middle East. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed an executive order because the country’s fuel supply is in imminent danger. 98% of the Philippines’ oil comes through the Persian Gulf, so the closure of the Strait of Hormuz has caused prices to double. This crisis is affecting everything from transportation to the price of food, such as rice. The government is taking strong measures to save energy, including a four-day working week for office employees and asking people to use stairs instead of lifts. The new emergency powers allow the government to control how food is distributed and how people move around the country. While the government is providing some financial help, many bus drivers say it is not enough to cover their costs. There are also concerns that the government might use these new powers to stop public protests planned for later this week. Difficult words: executive order (a special rule or law signed by a leader that must be followed immediately without waiting for a long discussion), imminent (coming or happening very soon), measure (a specific action that a person or a government takes to solve a problem or achieve a goal). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Philippines is in a national energy emergency . There is a war in the Middle East, and it is very hard for the Philippines to get oil. Because of this, the price of petrol and diesel is now twice as high as before. This makes life very difficult for ordinary people. Even the price of rice doubled because it is expensive to transport food to the cities. The president now has special powers to help the country. The government can control food and how much energy people use. Office workers now only work four days a week to save electricity. The government is giving some money to help drivers, but many people say it is not enough. People are planning to protest because living is becoming too expensive. Difficult words: emergency (a very serious and dangerous situation), ordinary (normal, not special), double (to become twice as much or twice as many as before). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a big problem with energy in the Philippines. There is a war far in Iran, and now oil is very expensive . The price of petrol is very high. It is also hard to buy food like rice. It costs a lot of money to také food from farms to shops. The president says that there is a problem with bringing oil. The country has new rules to save energy. For example, some people only work four days a week. Also, people should walk more and use a lift less. Many people are sad and angry because they do not have much money. They want the government to help them more. Difficult words: expensive (when something costs a lot of money), petrol (a fuel which you put in your car to make it go), lift (a machine which takes you up and down between floors of a building). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Chuck Norris, an American legend and martial arts icon , has passed away at the age of 86. He was hospitalized in Hawaii following a medical emergency. Just days before, he had celebrated his birthday in great spirits, even joking on social media that he doesn’t age; he levels up. His family released a touching statement describing him as a symbol of strength and a devoted family man. While many know him from his famous role in Walker, Texas Ranger or his numerous action movies, his career actually began in the US Air Force, where he started his martial arts training. Chuck Norris was a six-time undefeated karate champion and a black belt in seven different disciplines. He was not only a movie star but also a respected teacher who coached many other actors. He leaves behind a lasting impact as a patriot , and a beloved cultural figure who inspired millions. Difficult words: icon (a person who is very famous and represents a particular idea, style, or group of people), devoted (having great love for someone and spending a lot of time and energy supporting them), patriot (a person who loves their country very much). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Chuck Norris, the famous action star, died at the age of 86. He was in Hawaii with his family when he had a medical problem. He was very strong and healthy. Only a few days before, he had a birthday and spent time training. His family is very sad but says he was at peace . People all over the world know him from his TV show Walker, Texas Ranger, and many movies. Before he was an actor, he was in the military and became a champion in karate. He was a black belt in seven different martial arts . Chuck Norris was more than just a fighter; he was a kind father and grandfather. People will remember him as an American hero and a strong man. Difficult words: at peace (a calm and quiet feeling without pain or worry), martial arts (fighting like karate, judo, or kug-fu), hero (a strong and great person). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Chuck Norris is a very famous man. He is very strong and healthy for a long time. He is with his family in Hawaii. He gets sick and must go to the hospital. He dies this week at the age of 86. He is a great fighter and a movie star. Many people know him from the TV show Walker, Texas Ranger . But Chuck is a teacher, too. He teaches many people how to do karate . People on the internet love to tell jokes about how strong he is. Chuck Norris has a big family with five children. They say that he is a good father. People will always remember him as a good and strong man. Difficult words: healthy (not sick), karate (a Japanese fighting style when people use only their hands and feet), remember (to keep something in your mind). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Flash-panning is a modern dating trend similar to love bombing and ghosting. It starts with intense excitement, often including attention, dates, and shared experiences. The relationship might look perfect, especially on social media. However, when reality comes into play, like dealing with schedules or responsibilities, the person, called the flashpanner, suddenly disappears. Flashpanners are often novelty seekers who love the excitement of getting to know someone but lose interest once the relationship becomes more serious. They enjoy the fun stage but cannot manage conflicts or compromises that come later. Because of this, the relationship suddenly ends, leaving the other person confused or wondering what went wrong. Relationship expert Susan Winter says that flashpanners don’t understand that conflicts are normal in relationships. Since they don’t know how to handle them, they vanish without explanation, which is emotionally painful for the person left behind. Difficult words: novelty (something new and exciting), compromise (a way of reaching an agreement in which each person or group gives up something that was wanted to end the argument), vanish (to disappear quickly). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Flash-panning is a new way of dating, like love bombing and ghosting . It begins with a lot of fun and attention , such as exciting dates or trips. At first, the relationship seems perfect, especially on social media. But when real-life problems like schedules or responsibilities come, the person, called the flashpanner, leaves suddenly. Flashpanners enjoy the exciting start of a relationship but don’t want to deal with anything serious. When things get difficult, they go without any explanation . According to expert Susan Winter, flashpanners don’t know how to manage problems in relationships, so they leave instead of trying to solve them. This can hurt the other person, who may feel confused and sad. Difficult words: ghosting (suddenly ending all communication with another person), attention (noticing someone and regarding them as important), explanation (saying why), confused (not able to think clearly, surprised). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Flash-panning is a new way of dating . The relationship starts very fun and exciting. People go on fun dates and spend a lot of time together. Everything looks great on social media. But when there are real-life problems, like work or schedules , one person leaves. This person is the flashpanner. Flashpanners like the beginning of a relationship . The beginning is easy and fun. But they do not want to stay when things get hard. They do not talk about the problem. They just go away without saying goodbye. This can make the other person feel sad. It can be very hard to understand why the person is away. Difficult words: dating (meeting someone who you like a lot), schedule (a plan of events and times), relationship (how two or more people are connected). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This pop music quiz challenges true fans with 30 questions about iconic stars and their hits. It covers everything from chart-topping songs by Sabrina Carpenter and Olivia Rodrigo to hidden details about Taylor Swift’s discography. The quiz includes interesting trivia , such as the fact that Lady Gaga broke an attendance record in Brazil with 2.5 million fans at a single concert, and that Beyoncé holds the record for the most Grammy wins in history. The format keeps the audience engaged with different rounds, including guess the song in one second and a final round of quick yes-or-no questions. It also highlights the success of newer Gen Z stars like Benson Boone and Tate McRae. The ultimate goal is to see how much people really know about the music industry. The highest-grossing tour of all time, Taylor Swift’s Eras Tour, is the final answer, ending the quiz on a high note for pop culture followers. Difficult words: trivia (interesting but small facts about things like movies, music, or history that are used in games and quizzes), ultimate (the best, greatest, or most important example of something), high note (a very successful, pleasant, or positive way to end an event or a period of time). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Do you love pop music? This fun quiz has thirty questions about famous singers like Ariana Grande, Billie Eilish, and Miley Cyrus. You can test your memory on song titles and album covers. For example, did you know that Billie Eilish has the most -streamed song by a woman on Apple Music? Or that Beyoncé has won 35 Grammys? The quiz is not always easy. Some questions ask about small details, like the color of a shirt on a CD cover. There are also fast questions where you must listen to a song for only one second. At the end, you can count your points to see if you are a true fan. It is a great way to learn new facts about your favorite musical artists. Difficult words: streamed (music or video that you play directly from the internet without downloading it to your computer), point (what you get when you answer correctly), fact (a piece of information which is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This is a fun game about pop music. There are 30 questions about famous stars. Do you know Taylor Swift or Ariana Grande? You can guess their songs and look at their pictures. Some questions are easy, and some are hard. The quiz tells us many cool things. Beyoncé is the queen of music with many Grammys. Lady Gaga has a very big show with many people. You can play with your friends and see who has the best score . It is a happy game for people who love to listen to the radio and sing. Difficult words: guess (to try to answer), cool (something good and interesting), score (the number of points which you get in a game or quiz). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Denmark, trust plays a key role in society, especially in Copenhagen. For example, you can rent a kayak for free with GreenKayak, but the catch is that you must collect trash while paddling through the canals. Tobias Weber-Anderson started this initiative to clean the city’s waters. The system relies on people returning the kayaks without damage, which shows how trust works in Denmark. Another example is the Human Library, where you can borrow a person to have a conversation about personal stories. This project, led by Ronnie Auel, encourages open dialogue , helping people connect and understand one another better. Finally, in a local bakery, customers can buy bread without using a cashier. They help themselves, calculate the cost, and pay online. The bakery owner trusts customers to be honest, and cheating rarely happens. This way of life shows how much Danes value trust and responsibility in their community. Difficult words: initiative (a new plan or idea to solve a problem), dialogue (a conversation between two or more people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Trust is very important in Denmark, especially in Copenhagen. With GreenKayak, you can use a kayak for free if you pick up trash from the canals. The person who started this idea is Tobias Weber-Anderson, who wanted to make the city cleaner. This system works because people return the kayaks safely. The Human Library is another example of trust. You can borrow a person to talk with them about life problems. Ronnie Auel created this project to help people understand each other better. At a bakery, there is no cashier. Customers take what they want and pay online. The bakery owner trusts people to pay honestly, and usually, they do. In Denmark, people respect each other and act responsibly . Difficult words: trash (things which people throw away), project (an activity planned to achieve a goal), responsibly (when you do something in a careful trustworthy way). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Denmark, people trust each other a lot. You can borrow a kayak for free in Copenhagen if you clean trash from the water. This idea comes from Tobias Weber-Anderson. He wants to keep the city clean. People bring back the kayaks because they know trust is important. At the Human Library, you can talk to someone about their life. Ronnie Auel starts this to help people understand each other better. In a bakery, people buy bread without a cashier . They take the bread, count the price, and pay online. The owner trusts people to pay for what they take, and it works. People in Denmark respect each other. They try to do what is right. Difficult words: trust (to believe that someone will be honest), trash (things which people throw away), cashier (a person who gets money from people in a shop, restaurant, and so on). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

LED face masks have become a beauty trend on social media. These devices use red or blue light therapy to treat skin issues like acne , wrinkles, and inflammation. Many influencers promote them as a quick fix for better skin. Originally, LED technology was used in medical clinics and even by NASA to help heal wounds, but now anyone can buy a mask to use at home. However, some scientists and dermatologists are skeptical about how well these home devices actually work. They explain that the LED bulbs in home masks are much weaker than the professional machines used in clinics. While some users say the masks helped their skin, experts warn that there is not enough scientific evidence yet. Many studies are small or funded by the companies selling the masks. It is also important to use them safely, as some masks can damage the eyes if they don’t have proper protection. For now, LED masks are considered a complementary therapy rather than a complete cure for skin problems. Difficult words: acne (a skin condition where a person gets many small red spots, usually on their face), dermatologist (a special doctor who understands everything about the skin and helps people with skin problems), complementary (something that is used together with another thing to make it better or more complete). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many people today use LED masks to get better skin. These masks look like something from a movie and shine red or blue light on your face. Red light is usually for wrinkles , and blue light is for acne . You can use them at home for about ten minutes a day. Some people say their skin looks much better after using the mask. But scientists say we need to be careful. The masks you buy online are not as strong as the lights in a doctor’s office. Also, there are not many big studies to prove they work perfectly. Some experts think the reason why people feel better is that they feel relaxed while wearing the mask. If you have a skin problem, it is always a good idea to ask a doctor before buying such expensive tools. Difficult words: wrinkle (a line on your skin, usually when you get older), acne (small red spots on a person’s face), prove (to show that something is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people want to have beautiful skin . They buy new masks with LED lights. Some masks are red, and some are blue. You put the mask on your face for ten minutes. People say the lights help with skin problems. They see these masks on the internet and social media. But some doctors say that the masks are not very strong. They are different from the tools in a big hospital. We do not know if they work for everyone. Some people like them. Other people say that you spend a lot of money on nothing. It is important to be safe and protect your eyes. Always think before you buy new things online. Difficult words: skin (the top layer which is all over your body), tool (an object which you use with your hands, and it helps you do a job or task), protect (to keep something safe). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The leader of the Georgian Orthodox Church, Patriarch Ilia II, died at the age of 93. He led this powerful institution for nearly fifty years and was a very important figure in his country. He became the leader in 1977 when Georgia was still part of the Soviet Union. During that time, the state restricted religious practices , but he helped the church grow and have more influence. Ilia II was highly respected because he helped keep the country stable during difficult political times. He often acted as a mediator between different groups to prevent conflict. The church announced that he died in a hospital after a serious illness. A new leader will be elected within the next two months to take his place. Under his leadership, the Georgian church became very close to the state and became more important in public life. His death is a huge loss for the Orthodox Church and for the people of Georgia, who saw him as a spiritual father. Difficult words: restrict (to put a limit on what someone is allowed to do), practice (doing something regularly, like a religion or a hobby, to keep it part of your life), mediator (a person who helps two groups to reach an agreement). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Ilia II, the head of the Georgian Church, died last week. He was 93 years old. He led the church for a very long time, since 1977. At that time, it was hard to practice religion in Georgia, which belonged to the Soviet Union. But Ilia II worked hard, and the church became very strong. Many people in the country loved and respected him. He helped the country when there were big problems or fights between politicians. He was a calm leader who wanted peace for everyone. The church says he was a very important person in history. Now, the church must choose a new leader in two months. People in Georgia are very sad because they lost their spiritual leader . He was like a father to many people in Georgia. Difficult words: church (a large religious organization with its own rules), respect (to like someone because they are good, kind, or have an important job), spiritual leader (a person who shows others how to live according to their religion and helps them feel good). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A very important leader in Georgia dies. His name is Ilia II. He is 93 years old. He was the boss of the church for a long time. Ilia II starts his work in 1977. It is not easy. Georgia belongs to the Soviet Union at that time. Many people in the country love him. They think he is a very good man. Ilia II helps people when they are sad or angry. He wants everyone to be friends. He works for many years to make the church big and strong. He is a spiritual father to many people. Now the people in Georgia are very sad . The church must choose a new boss in two months. Difficult words: church (a religious organization), spiritual father (a leader who cares for people’s hearts and beliefs, just like a father cares for a child), sad (not happy). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The war in Iran is causing a sudden increase in petrol prices across Europe. Global energy markets are unstable because of the conflict and the partia l closure of the Strait of Hormuz, a key route for oil. Data shows that between late February and early March, countries like Germany and Austria saw prices rise by as much as 14%. In Germany, the price of a litre of petrol jumped from 1.82 euros to over 2.00 euros in just a few weeks. Governments are now looking for ways to protect drivers. For example, Germany is looking at new laws to stop gas stations from changing prices several times a day. Austria has already limited how often prices can go up. Meanwhile, Hungary has introduced a price cap specifically for cars with Hungarian license plates to prevent fuel tourism from neighboring countries. Experts warn that if oil prices continue to rise, European drivers could pay an extra 150 million euros every day. Difficult words: partial (something that is not complete or does not cover the whole part of something), price cap (a rule made by the government that sets the maximum amount of money a shop or company can charge for a product), fuel tourism (a situation where people drive across a border to another country to buy cheaper petrol or diesel). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Petrol is becoming very expensive in Europe because of the war in Iran. When there is a war in a country with oil, the price of fuel goes up everywhere. In Germany and Austria, the price rose by about 13% or 14% in only two weeks. This is a big problem for people who drive to work. European governments want to help. In Austria and Germany, gas stations can only raise their prices at certain times. In Hungary, the government put a limit on the price for local drivers. Experts think prices might stay high for a long time. If the oil price stays above 100 dollars, people in Europe will pay millions of euros more every day for petrol. Difficult words: fuel (a substance like petrol, diesel, or wood which makes power for a machine), gas station (a place where you stop your car to buy petrol or diesel so you can keep driving), limit (the greatest or smallest amount of something that is allowed or possible). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a war in Iran. The price of petrol in Europe is very high. In Germany, one litre of petrol costs more than 2 euros. This is a big problem for many people. It is hard to buy fuel for cars. Governments in Europe want to help. They make new rules for gas stations . In some countries, the price cannot change many times in one day. Some countries that say the price must stay low for their people, for example, Hungary. Everyone wants the war to stop and the prices to go down again. It is important to save money when things are expensive. Difficult words: price (how much something costs), fuel (a substance like petrol, diesel, or wood which makes power for a machine), gas station (a place where you stop your car to buy petrol or diesel so you can keep driving). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Thousands of teachers in Mexico City started a 72-hour national strike to demand better working conditions. The protesters marched from the Angel of Independence to the Zócalo, which is the main square of the capital. They want a salary increase and the repeal of specific laws that affect their pensions and careers. The teachers feel that the government hasn’t kept its promises to help them. The leaders of the teachers’ union announced that they will continue their fight if the president doesn’t talk to them. They even mentioned that they might organize more protests during the World Cup to get more attention. At the moment, teachers in more than 20 states are taking part in different actions, such as blocking roads and taking over government buildings. After their march, the teachers planned to set up a camp in the square and visit several embassies. They want to show that they are organized and ready for a long struggle to protect their rights. Difficult words: demand (a very strong statement where you say that you must have something or that something must happen), repeal (the act of officially ending a law), union (an organized group of workers who join together to talk to their boss about better pay and better working conditions). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many teachers in Mexico are very angry with the government. They started a three-day strike to ask for more money and better rules for their jobs. Thousands of people walked through the streets of Mexico City to the big central square. They say the president must talk to them now. If the government doesn’t listen, the teachers want to protest during the World Cup. This protest is happening in many parts of the country. Some teachers block roads or stay in government buildings. In the capital, the teachers built a camp to stay for 72 hours. They want everyone to see their problem. They also visited embassies to show how strong they are. These teachers are ready to fight for their rights . Difficult words: camp (a place where people stay in tents or simple shelters for a short time, often outside), em bassy (a building where people from another country work and represent their own government), right (something that you are allowed to do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many teachers in Mexico are not happy. They want more money for their work. They walk in the streets of Mexico City. Thousands of people go to the main square . They stop work for three days. They want to talk to the president. The teachers make a camp in the square. They stay there for a long time. They say that there must be better rules. They want to change the rules. If the president does not help, teachers will protest again. Teachers in many cities are part of this plan. They want a good life for every teacher. Difficult words: square (an open area in a village or city where people can meet), camp (a place where people stay in tents for a short time, often outside), protest (to come together to show that you are angry or unhappy about something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The mayoral election in Paris has become a battle over trash and cleanliness. Candidate Rachida Dati recently released a campaign video where she empties bins and climbs onto a garbage truck. She promises voters that she will make the city clean again if she wins. Dati argues that the current organization is not effective because different groups of workers handle different cleaning tasks without coordination . Many residents in Paris feel disgusted by the state of their streets. A study shows that many people rank cleanliness as a top issue, right after security. They complain about garbage and dog excrement that appear every morning despite nightly cleaning. Some political analysts say that the filthy city theme is a usual tactic used by certain politicians for many years. Politicians argue that some citizen groups are taking action themselves. They believe that keeping the city clean is everyone’s responsibility, not just the job of the government. They want people to respect the places where children play and the elderly walk. Difficult words: mayoral election (whern people in a city vote to choose a new leader), coordination (making parts of a system work together), disgusted (a very strong feeling of dislike when you see, smell, or hear something very dirty or bad), tactic (a specific plan or clever method that someone uses to achieve a goal or win something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Paris has a big problem with trash, and it is a main topic in the new election. Rachida Dati wants to be the new mayor . She made a video to show that she can clean the streets. She even worked on a garbage truck to show she is serious. Many people who live in Paris are unhappy. They say the roads are dirty every day. They want the city to look beautiful and clean again. Dati says the current system of collecting trash is bad. She wants a new plan to collect trash and wash the streets at the same time. Some experts say politicians always talk about dirt to get more votes. Some people don’t wait for the government to help. They clean the streets themselves. They say everyone must help to keep the city good for children and old people. Difficult words: mayor (the official leader and boss of a city or a town), garbage truck (a large vehicle that travels to houses and streets to collect trash and take it away), collect (to pick up things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Paris is a very famous city. But it is very dirty. Now there is a big election for the city’s new boss. One person is Rachida Dati. She wants to clean the city. She makes a video with a big garbage truck . She says that the rules do not work. Many people in Paris are sad. They see dirty streets every morning. They want a clean place for their children. Some people say that dirty streets are a good topic before an election. But nothing happens after the election. Some people do not wait for a new boss. They clean the streets with their friends. They say that it is important to help the city. Everyone wants Paris to be a beautiful place again. Difficult words: election (when people choose a person for a job in the government), garbage truck (a big car which goes to houses and streets, picks trash and takes it away), topic (a specific subject or idea which people talk or write about). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Eden Project in Cornwall, UK, recently celebrated its 25th birthday. This famous destination transformed an old clay pit into a world-class attraction with domes that house a giant indoor rainforest. Over the years, millions of people, including many school children, have visited to learn about nature and wild landscapes. The site even uses geothermal energy from deep underground to keep the tropical plants warm and healthy. However, the project now faces serious financial challenges. Since the pandemic, the number of visitors has dropped by half, which has led to large financial losses. Because of these problems, the organization had to cut many staff positions to save money. This situation puts the future of the famous greenhouses in jeopardy . Despite these difficulties, the founder is hopeful and wants to inspire young people to believe in big dreams. The site continues to offer new experiences, such as a fast zip wire, to attract more tourists. The goal is to keep this unique place open for future generations to enjoy. Difficult words: clay pit (a large hole in the ground where people take out a special kind of earth to make things like plates or bricks), jeopardy (a situation where something is in danger of failing, being lost, or being destroyed), unique (something that is the only one of its kind and is very special because there is nothing else like it). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Eden Project is twenty-five years old. It is a very large garden in Cornwall, UK, with big glass domes . Inside these domes, there is a real rainforest with many different plants. Millions of people go there every year to see the trees and learn about the world. The project uses hot water from under the ground to stay warm. It is a very special place for families and schools. But today, the project has some big problems. Fewer people visit the gardens now, so the company doesn’t have enough money. They had to tell many workers to leave their jobs. The leaders are sad about this, but they want to keep the dream alive . They hope that new visitors will come back soon to see the beautiful forest. Difficult words: dome (a roof which looks like half of a ball, often seen on top of large buildings or greenhouses), rainforest (a forest in a hot part of the world where it rains a lot and many tall trees and animals live), alive (living, not dead). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Eden Project is a very big garden in England. It has a large rainforest inside big glass balls. Many people visit this place to see the green trees. Children go there with their schools. They learn about nature there. It is a beautiful and happy place. But the garden has a problem now. Many people do not visit the place today. The company does not have much money. Some people lose their jobs. There is not enough money for them. It is hard to keep the garden open. The boss of the project is still happy. He wants to help young people dream big. He wants to save the trees and the glass balls. He hopes that many people will come back to visit soon. Difficult words: rainforest (a forest in a hot part of the world where it rains a lot), nature (all the things in the world like plants, animals, mountains, and rivers), project (some work or activity which people do over a period of time). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Meta’s Ray-Ban smart glasses are at the center of a privacy scandal . Over seven million people bought these glasses because they look like normal sunglasses but contain cameras and AI. However, a new investigation shows that human workers in Kenya often review private videos from the glasses. These workers see very personal moments, such as people getting undressed or using credit cards. Although Meta says they blur faces to protect privacy, contractors confirm the system often fails. Many users don’t realize that strangers might watch their recordings to improve the AI technology. This situation is very uncomfortable for both users and people who are filmed without their permission. Now, some countries are demanding more information from Meta about how they use this data. In the United States, users filed a lawsuit against the company for violating privacy laws. Meta says they only see footage when users share it, but experts warn that people lose control over their personal information once it enters the AI system. Difficult words: scandal (a situation where many people are shocked or angry because someone did something wrong or dishonest), blur (a way to make a picture or a face difficult to see clearly, often used to hide a person’s identity), contractor (a person or company that does work for another company), violate (an action where someone breaks a rule, a law, or a person’s rights). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

More than seven million people bought Meta’s Ray-Ban smart glasses last year. Many people use smart glasses to record videos and talk to AI. These glasses look normal, but they have a hidden camera. A new report says that workers in Africa watch many of these private videos. They see people in their homes and even see credit card details. This is a big problem for privacy . Meta says they try not to show people’s faces in the videos, but the workers say they can still see many people. Most users don’t know that strangers watch their videos. They think only the AI looks at the data. Now, the government in the UK and some people in the USA want answers. They say Meta must be honest about their rules. People should be careful when using these glasses. Difficult words: hidden (something that you cannot see easily), private (something that is only for you or a small group of people, and not for everyone else to see or know), privacy (the right to keep your personal life and information secret from other people or companies). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people buy new smart glasses. These glasses have a small camera. They look like simple sunglasses. People use them to take videos. But there is a big problem with privacy . Workers in Africa watch these videos. They see people in their houses. They see faces and personal things. This is a bad problem. Most people do not know about this. They think their videos are safe. Now, many people are angry . They talk to the boss at Meta. They want to stop this. They say that the company must follow the rules. It is important to be safe with new technology. Difficult words: simple (not difficult), privacy (when other people do not know information about you or your life), angry (a strong feeling when something bad or unfair happens). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Launched in 2017, Squishmallows became highly popular due to their softness, cute designs, and collectible nature. The brand has grown internationally, expanding to over 55 countries and winning awards, including seven Toy of the Year honors. Squishmallows are not just toys; many collectors say they have helped them emotionally. People often form connections with Squishmallows because each has its name, personality, and biography. These characteristics make it easy to feel attached to the plushies , which many find comforting, especially when dealing with stress or trauma. In addition to emotional benefits, some collect Squishmallows for financial reasons. Limited editions and exclusive releases have created a large resale market, with some plushies selling for more than double their retail price. Although the brand continues to expand, it is unclear if Squishmallows will remain as popular in the future due to increasing supply and collection fatigue among buyers. Difficult words: collectible (an item people save or buy because it has value), plushy (a soft toy), fatigue (exhaustion, tiredness). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Squishmallows are soft stuffed toys that first appeared in 2017 and already won many awards. They are popular because they are soft, cute, and easy to collect. People can buy Squishmallows in over 55 countries. They like to collect them, and some say that Squishmallows help them feel better when they are sad or stressed. Each Squishmallow has its name and story, which helps people feel closer to them. Some people collect Squishmallows to sell them for more money. Because some Squishmallows are harder to find, they can cost more than twice their original price. Even though the brand keeps growing, it is not clear if it will stay as popular in the future as it is now. Difficult words: stuffed (a to with a soft filling inside), collect (to gather and keep), original (the first or earliest). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Squishmallows are toys. They are very soft and cute, and people like to collect them. People can buy them since 2017. Many people feel happy when they get a Squishmallow. Each Squishmallow has its name and story. This makes them special to people. People find them helpful when they feel sad. Some Squishmallows are hard to find. People buy Squishmallows and then sell them for more money. People in 55 countries can buy these toys. They win a lot of best toy awards . But it is not clear if they will stay as popular as they are now. There are many of them already. Difficult words: collect (to gather and keep), helpful (giving help), award (a prize for someone or something very good or special). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Daniil Medvedev won a tennis match against Jack Draper, but one moment caused a lot of talk. During a point, Draper moved his arms because he thought a ball was out. Medvedev continued to play but felt distracted by the movement. After the point ended, Medvedev asked the umpire to check the video. The umpire decided that Draper’s gesture was a hindrance and gave the point to Medvedev. The crowd was not happy and booed the decision. After the match, journalists asked Medvedev if his action was fair. Medvedev said that he didn’t feel like a cheat. He admitted that he was only a little distracted, but he followed the rules of the game. He explained that he let the referee make the final choice. Medvedev and Draper spoke at the net after the game. Draper felt that the distraction was not big enough to stop the point. However, both players still have a good relationship. Medvedev said he would accept any decision from the official. Difficult words: umpire (a person who sits in a high chair in tennis to watch the game and make sure everyone follows the rules), gesture (a movement of the hands or body), hindrance (something that makes a situation difficult). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Daniil Medvedev beat Jack Draper in a big tennis match. During the game, Draper strangely moved his hand. Medvedev saw this and felt a bit distracted . After they finished the point, Medvedev asked the referee to look at a video. The referee said Draper made a mistake and gave the point to Medvedev. Many people in the crowd made a loud noise because they didn’t like the call. Medvedev spoke to reporters later. He said he didn’t cheat. He told them he was not very distracted, but the rule is the rule. He let the referee decide what to do. Draper and Medvedev are still friends. Draper thinks the move didn’t change the game much. Medvedev says he feels okay about his choice . Difficult words: distracted (when you cannot think about one thing because there is something else), referee (a person in sports who decides about the play), choice (when you choose between two or more different things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Zhangjiagang is an industrial city that uses advanced technology to treat household waste. Instead of putting waste in landfills, the city uses incineration , a process where waste is burned in a smart and fully enclosed facility. This process creates electricity and heat that is reused in nearby factories. Thanks to this method, the city has entered a zero landfill era, where no household waste is buried in the ground. The waste treatment center is very modern and clean. There is no bad smell or visible garbage. Everything is monitored and controlled through a central system. Even kitchen waste is burned together with regular waste to produce more energy. The plant produces enough electricity each year for around 60,000 households. After incineration, the remaining residue is not thrown away. Companies turn it into construction materials, and the steam produced during the process is piped to small businesses for daily use. Hazardous waste is also handled safely. Through technology and teamwork between companies, Zhangjiagang has created a full recycling system that protects the environment. Difficult words: incineration (burning waste), residue (what is left after something is burned or removed), hazardous (dangerous or harmful). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Zhangjiagang is a city in China that has a new and smart way of treating household waste . It doesn’t use landfills anymore. Now, a computer system controls burning the waste in a special, closed building. This makes electricity and heat for homes and factories. The place is very clean, and there is no smell or trash on the ground. Kitchen waste and household waste are burned together, which gives more power. The city makes enough electricity for 60,000 homes every year. After burning, the rest of the waste goes to companies that make building materials. The heat from burning helps small businesses nearby. Workers handle dangerous waste safely. The system uses waste to help people and protect the environment. Difficult words: smart (clever), waste (things and materials which people throw away), landfill (a place where people put waste in the ground). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Zhangjiagang is a city in China. It has a new way to take care of waste . People do not put trash in the ground now. The city burns trash in a special place. This makes power and heat. The place is clean. It has no smell. A computer helps control the work. Food waste and home waste go in together. The power helps people in their homes. It is enough for 60,000 homes. After burning, some waste is used to make things for building. The hot air goes to small shops. Dangerous waste also goes to a safe place. This new way helps people and keeps the city clean. Difficult words: waste (things which people throw away), power (energy which helps machines and lights work), dangerous (not safe). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Scientists and communities are making great progress in nature conservation . In the Democratic Republic of Congo, people create a large area for animals to travel safely between parks. This project also helps local groups own their land again after many years. At the same time, experts discover thousands of new species every year, which shows that our planet still has many secrets to share. New technology is also protecting ocean life from danger. Companies now use special cameras and computer programs to find whales near large ships. This system sends an alert to the crew to prevent accidents. Furthermore, researchers use drones to put cameras on blue whales. This method doesn’t cause stress to the animals and helps us understand how climate change affects their behavior in the wild. In the energy sector, battery storage is now much cheaper and more efficient . This change allows businesses to use solar power even during the night. Also, the European Union introduces new rules for the clothing industry to reduce waste. These laws force companies to pay for the environmental damage they cause. This move helps fight the problem of low-quality clothes that people throw away quickly. Difficult words: conservation (the protection of natural things), species (a group of animals or plants that are the same), efficient (working well without wasting anything). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many good things happened in the world in February. In Africa, people built a large path for animals to move safely. This helps nature and gives land back to local communities. Also, scientists find more than 16,000 new plants and animals every year. We learn more about our world every day. New technology helps save whales in the ocean. A new computer system finds whales near ships and tells the captain to move the ship or slow down. This way, the ship doesn’t hit the animal. Other experts use drones to watch blue whales. They want to see how these big animals live and find food. Clean energy is now cheaper for everyone. Batteries for solar power cost much less than before. Now, we can use the sun to get light at night too. In Europe, new rules stop fashion companies from making too much waste . These companies must pay more money if they hurt the planet. Difficult words: path (a track for walking), captain (the person who is the leader of a ship or a plane), waste (things which you throw away). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Companies must not make too much trash. They must help the planet. Difficult words: wild (an animal which lives free), secret (something what people do not know), solar power (energy from the sun). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
